وَالسَّمَآءِ وَالطَّارِقِۙ‏
By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein)
وَمَا٘ اَدۡرٰىكَ مَا الطَّارِقُۙ‏
And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is
النَّجۡمُ الثَّاقِبُۙ‏
(It is) the Star of piercing brightness
اِنۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٌؕ‏
There is no soul but has a protector over it
فَلۡيَنۡظُرِ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَؕ‏
Now let man but think from what he is created
خُلِقَ مِنۡ مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍۙ‏
He is created from a drop emitted
يَّخۡرُجُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ الصُّلۡبِ وَالتَّرَآئِبِؕ‏
Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs
اِنَّهٗ عَلٰي رَجۡعِهٖ لَقَادِرٌؕ‏
Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)
يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَي السَّرَآئِرُۙ‏
The Day that (all) things secret will be tested
فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ قُوَّةٍ وَّلَا نَاصِرٍؕ‏
(Man) will have no power, and no helper
وَالسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجۡعِۙ‏
By the Firmament which returns (in its round)
وَالۡاَرۡضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدۡعِۙ‏
And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation)
اِنَّهٗ لَقَوۡلٌ فَصۡلٌۙ‏
Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil)
وَّمَا هُوَ بِالۡهَزۡلِؕ‏
It is not a thing for amusement
اِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيۡدُوۡنَ كَيۡدًاۙ‏
As for them, they are but plotting a scheme
وَّاَكِيۡدُ كَيۡدًاۚۖ‏
And I am planning a scheme
فَمَهِّلِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدًاࣖ‏
Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile)
